A renowned medical doctor and internationally recognised philanthropist, Musa Audu, has declared support for the second-term ambition of President Bola Tinubu.
He said Tinubu was capable of taking Nigeria to a level of lasting political stability, a predictable economy, human capital development and national infrastructure upgraded to international standards.
In a statement on Sunday, Audu said, “President Tinubu, in his determination to take Nigeria to greater heights, is capable of working with all right-thinking Nigerians who believe in equity before the law, fairness in the allocation of the commonwealth, and justice for all without discrimination.”
He also appraised the performance of the Kwara State Government, which he adjudged the best since the beginning of the country’s current democratic experiment.
According to him, the principles of equity and equality upheld by the Kwara State Governor and All Progressives Congress leader in the state, AbdulRahman AbdulRazak, who is also the chairman of the Nigeria Governors’ Forum and the Sardauna of Ilorin Emirate, are timely and consistent with the law of God for both minority and majority groups.
The philanthropist also gave a pass mark to the leadership of the Kwara State House of Assembly under the Speaker, Saliu Danlandi, who is also the APC’s governorship flag bearer in the 2027 election.
MIA declared support for the New Kwara South project and for all the APC candidates in the district in the 2027 elections.
